title: National Museum of Pakistan
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap relation 7605753 records the approximately 48 m by 64 m museum envelope, two enclosed courtyards, and a 37 m section of west facade where the Burns Garden pedestrian approach meets the building.
sectionBasis: The garden entrance has a projecting sign canopy under nine cream masonry screens set against dark openings. The red fascia separates this base from the repeated concrete fins, two rows of inset glazing and two stepped folded rooflines.
limitations: The cleared 2008 image establishes the west façade pattern and finish. The exact height, depth of the upper pavilion, courtyard elevations, and south, north and east elevations are approximate.

Unmodified composite terrain rises toward the rear. The approach datum is approximate, and higher original elevation samples conceal parts of the lower side and rear walls. The courtyard extent is mapped, and its floor elevations are estimated.
floorBasis: The public floor is 0.62 m above the original approach datum. The unmodified composite terrain rises sharply toward the rear, where the lower levels meet or enter the terrain.
